title: Mean-field dynamics of attractive resource interaction: From uniform to aggregated states
summary: We introduce and study a nonlinear discrete dynamical system describing the evolution of a resource distribution among interacting agents. The model generalizes several classical mean-field and opinion-dynamics frameworks and is defined on the standard simplex, where each coordinate evolves according to an interaction rule depending on preference-based mean-field interactions. We provide a complete analytical description of the long-term behavior of the system.
